description: Read JazzHR jobs, applicants, recruiting activities and reference data.

jazzhr_new_activitie_trigger.description: Runs for each new activity in JazzHR. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, title, first_name, last_name, email
